maddeler.e:
تبادرت (form VI)
# تَبَادَرْتُ (tabādartu) /ta.baː.dar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
# تَبَادَرْتَ (tabādarta) /ta.baː.dar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
# تَبَادَرْتِ (tabādarti) /ta.baː.dar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
# تَبَادَرَتْ (tabādarat) /ta.baː.da.rat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
